info.name: Epic Wedplanner API
info.description: Epic Wedplanner authentication, public and admin service catalog, Cloudinary uploads, and manual KYC review. Import the matching Postman environment. Save each document number and upload its image in separate requests; both write to the same document row. Submit the company form last.

request.description: Copy the OTP from the email into emailOtp. Verification does not sign the user in.
Saves vendor access token, refresh token, and user ID to the active Postman environment.
Google ID token must be issued for GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID. role is needed only for a new account.
Rotates the vendor refresh token and saves the new access and refresh tokens to the active environment.
Can also use the httpOnly refresh cookie.
Choose a local file in Postman. Allowed types: JPEG, PNG, WebP, PDF. purpose can be kyc-pan, kyc-aadhaar, kyc-gst, kyc-cin, company-logo, avatar, favicon_icon, header_logo, or other.
Select a masked Aadhaar card image. Saves its Cloudinary URL as aadhaarUploadUrl.
Confirms that the authenticated vendor can access vendor-only routes.
Saves the PAN number to its KYC document row. Upload the matching image separately; either order works.
Saves the Aadhaar number to its KYC document row. Upload the matching image separately; either order works.
Saves the GSTIN number to its KYC document row. Upload the matching image separately; either order works.
Saves the CIN number to its KYC document row. Upload the matching image separately; either order works.

Final vendor KYC form with multiple service categories/subcategories, company profile, social links, sources, and a submitted document checklist. The verified object is only the vendor's declaration; admin-controlled document verification is not changed by it. Save PAN and Aadhaar numbers and upload both card images first. GSTIN and CIN remain optional, but each optional document needs both its number and image.
Confirms that the authenticated admin can access admin-only routes.

item.name: Public service catalog
item.description: Read-only service catalog endpoints for public pages. No authentication is required. Create the sample category and subcategory from the Admin service catalog folder first if the database is empty.

request.description: Returns paginated categories with complete subcategories. search checks category and nested subcategory names/descriptions. Exact id and slug filters are also supported; remove search when it is not needed.

item.name: Get selected public category with subcategories

request.description: Use this after a public user selects a category. The response includes the selected category and all of its subcategories.

item.name: List public subcategories for selected category

request.description: Returns subcategories belonging to the selected category and matching search. Exact id and slug filters are also supported. Remove search when it is not needed.
Returns one subcategory and its parent service category.

item.name: Admin service catalog
item.description: Admin-only CRUD for service categories and subcategories. Run Create categories first, then create subcategories separately using the saved category ID.

request.description: Creates categories only. Send one array item for one category or multiple items for bulk creation. Create subcategories separately after this request using POST /admin/service-subcategories and the saved serviceCategoryId. If any category fails, nothing from this request is created.
Returns paginated categories with complete subcategories and _count.subcategories. search checks category and nested subcategory names/descriptions. Exact id and slug filters are also supported.
Returns one service category and its complete subcategories array.
Updates one category only. The category ID is supplied in the URL and the body contains only fields to change. Update subcategories separately with PATCH /admin/service-subcategories/:id.
Deletes the category only when it has no subcategories. If subcategories exist, the API returns 409 Conflict. Delete them or move them to another category first.

Creates a subcategory. Required fields: name and serviceCategoryId. Optional fields: description, imageUrl, and imagePublicId. You may alternatively upload an image using multipart/form-data with a file field.
Updates one subcategory only. This request does not update the parent category. serviceCategoryId is optional and is used only when moving the subcategory to another existing category.
Confirms that the authenticated super admin can access super-admin-only routes.
